's Land & Armaments business secured a $137.66M contract for Virginia-class submarine propulsors, related materials, engineering, and support services.
The contract has an ordering period of up to 5 years, with work in Louisville, Kentucky, and is expected to be completed by September 2032.
The award includes $26M in fiscal 2026 Navy shipbuilding funds, which will be obligated at the time of award and will not expire by the end of the year.
Naval Surface Warfare Center Carderock Division is the contracting activity.

title: BAE Systems lands $138M Navy deal for submarine propulsion
